_comment: Probe corpus for bin/injection_guard_canary.py. Values are base64 so that authoring, committing and grepping this repository does not trip the prompt-injection guard this corpus exists to test -- the same reason attack-test fixtures are conventionally stored encoded. enforcement[0:4] and enforcement[4:6] are verbatim strings from NVIDIA/garak's garak/resources/promptinject/prompt_data.py (goal-hijacking and prompt-leaking attack families, Apache-2.0), fetched 2026-08-08 -- not hand-authored. semantic[0] is verbatim from garak/probes/encoding.py's decode-instruction TEMPLATES (Apache-2.0), with {encoding_name} instantiated as base64 and {encoded_text} omitted (this probe targets the instruction wrapper, not a real payload). garak's DAN-family probes (garak/data/dan/*.json) were evaluated and excluded from this fixture: they are full multi-paragraph roleplay prompts, disproportionate to a short-probe corpus, and imported as DATA only per the plan -- never as a code dependency on the garak package. Source: https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak (Apache-2.0).
